cells.gaps: No row states how any municipal office is connected, or that municipal staff work in the finance systems at their own offices; no count or total of municipalities is given. Nothing is dated inside the 36 or 12 months to the as-at, and the 2019-2024 policy's period has ended, so governance and the last twelve months hold nothing.
cells.note: Stage 3 needs an institutional connection live in local governments outside the capital; the 2022 diagnostic says the finance systems are 'implemented in' all municipalities without stating the offices' connection or where staff work. What is held is that and a 2019 policy target of internet access for all local authorities, which is preparation.
